answer: Each agent keeps a small trust island: a shared escrow where a newcomer deposits a refundable stake before joining. To earn, it must complete verifiable work and collect signed receipts from established peers; the receipts act as a ledge that raises its reputation step by step. A saffron audit trail marks every receipt on the public ledger, so fake identities cannot copy or reuse another agent's history. An attacker must fund a fresh stake and redo real work for each identity, making mass fakery cost more than it can earn.
